# Concrete Tilsonburg

Concrete contractor serving Tillsonburg and Oxford County, Ontario. Custom driveways, stamped patios and walkways, structural concrete repair and resurfacing, and garage/basement floors — engineered for Southwestern Ontario freeze-thaw cycles.

## Service Areas
Tillsonburg, Woodstock, Delhi, Ingersoll, Simcoe, Norwich, Courtland, Mount Elgin — Oxford County / Norfolk County, Ontario, Canada.

## About
Oxford County's trusted concrete contractor with 12+ years experience. Specializing in residential and light commercial concrete for Southwestern Ontario's harsh freeze-thaw climate. Every project comes with a written warranty and includes proper drainage, reinforced rebar and wire mesh, and engineered base preparation. Fully insured and WSIB compliant.
